31700-XIV.s: The bill formally establishes the 2009 budget statements for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and its agency budgets, in thousands of euros. It also sets aside Comptabiliteitswet 2001 provisions for the ministry as part of a trial to improve political accountability, so that the policy-article explanation is given per policy article.
31700-XIV.j: The memorandum justifies the deviation from Comptabiliteitswet 2001 as necessary for a time-limited experiment (2007-2009) to improve political accountability, agreed with the Tweede Kamer.
q: For the experiment it is necessary for those years to deviate from several provisions of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 on the structure of the departmental budget and annual report.

Ten behoeve van het experiment is het noodzakelijk voor die jaren af te wijken van een aantal bepalingen van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 met betrekking tot de inrichting van de departementale begroting en het departementale jaarverslag.

31700-XVI.s: The bill formally adopts the 2009 budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the budgets of four baten-lastendiensten, expressed in thousands of euros. It also allows the budget explanatory notes for this ministry to present the required per-policy-article information only where needed, as part of a government experiment in budget reporting.
31700-XVI.j: The memorandum justifies the departure from Comptabiliteitswet 2001 article 5 as part of a government experiment to improve political accountability for 2007 to 2009.
q: The experiment, as regards the budgets, concerns the substance of the explanatory notes to the budget.
Het experiment heeft wat de begrotingen betreft inhoudelijk betrekking op de toelichting bij de begroting.

31965-XII.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Transport and Water Management, adjusting appropriations across policy articles and non-policy articles following the spring budget memorandum. It also amends Article 66 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 for the ministry's accountancy service, requiring an auditor's statement covering financial information, compliance with the legality requirement, and consistency of non-financial information.
q: The results of the audit are recorded annually in reports addressed to Our relevant Minister.
De resultaten van de controle worden jaarlijks vastgelegd in rapporten die zijn gericht aan Onze betrokken Minister.

32020-(R1887).s: The bill establishes a joint Raad voor de rechtshandhaving (Law Enforcement Council) for Curaçao, Sint Maarten and the BES islands, with the task of inspecting police, prosecution, detention, probation and other justice-chain bodies, and sets out its powers, staffing, budget and reporting. It also allows each country to assign the Council advisory tasks on complaints and oversight of police data processing.
32020-(R1887).j: The memorandum justifies the Council's powers and ministerial role by the need for objective, independent inspection that supports ministerial responsibility, citing the 2006 Slotverklaring agreement.
q: The Council's factual judgement must not be influenced by political interference.
Het feitelijke oordeel van de Raad mag niet door politieke bemoeienis worden beïnvloed.
d: ministers may issue directions to the Council on annual plan implementation
legal status of Council members by general administrative measure
rules on formation and size of equalisation reserves
manner of ordering vehicles to stop, set by Council regulation
national law may assign complaint advice and police data oversight to the Council
Council exercises ministerial powers under staff regulations
p: Ministers may give binding directions on the Council's annual plan, though not on methodology, findings or reports, and only after consultation.
The Council may alert parliament and the Council of Ministers when ministers consistently ignore its recommendations.
Inspection reports are published only after six weeks and parts may be withheld on listed grounds, limiting public scrutiny.
Ministers must send parliaments an evaluation report within five years of entry into force.

parties: Questions the added value of the Council and objects that its inspection work escapes oversight by the parliaments of the countries, with appointments made only by ministers and wide repressive powers lacking checks.
Objects to the binding nature of the act on autonomous countries, to broad inspection and information-demand powers without safeguards, and asks who will oversee the Council itself.
Too far-reaching, the faction judges, expressing concern that the countries wish to introduce a new legal figure without adequate safeguards.
Te vergaand, oordeelt de fractie, die in dit verband haar zorgen uit over het feit dat de landen een nieuwe rechtsfiguur willen introduceren zonder dat dit met voldoende waarborgen is omkleed.
Broadly supports an inspection body for improving law enforcement but asks for clear criteria for unannounced inspections and clearer appointment expertise requirements.

For the PAR faction, however, it is important that during the handling of this bill in the States General the difference between the right of amendment ... and the right of self-determination is kept sharply in view.

Voor de PAR-fractie is het echter wel van belang dat bij de behandeling van het onderhavige voorstel van rijkswet in de Staten-Generaal scherp voor ogen wordt gehouden het verschil tussen het recht van amendement ... en het zelfbeschikkingsrecht.

Sees a serious infringement on the autonomy of Curaçao and Sint Maarten, a new inspection body with far-reaching powers without democratic control by local bodies, and regrets the omitted termination clause advised by the Raad van Advies.

Not only the manner in which this proposal came about raises questions, the independent member says, but also that a wholly new inspection body with very far-reaching powers is created without democratically legitimised bodies of Curaçao and Sint Maarten being able to exercise proper control.

Niet alleen de wijze van totstandkoming van het onderhavige voorstel roept de nodige vragen op, aldus het onafhankelijke lid, maar ook het feit dat uit kracht van dit voorstel een geheel nieuw inspectielichaam in het leven wordt geroepen met zeer vergaande bevoegdheden.
Doubts the need and scope of the council, its overlap with existing inspectorates, and its relation to the prosecution service's magistrate role.

The picture emerging from these documents is of a general supervisor alongside or above the existing supervisors, without it being entirely clear what tasks and powers the latter have or retain in the overseas territories.

Het beeld dat uit voorliggende stukken opdoemt, is een algemene toezichthouder naast dan wel boven de bestaande toezichthouders, waarbij het nog niet geheel duidelijk is welke taken en bevoegdheden laatstgenoemden hebben of houden in de overzeese gebieden.
Asks for a clear account of ministerial authority and existing instruction powers before judging the council's supervisory role.
These members want a clear picture of the Council's supplementary supervisory task, including its relation to other control and steering options, before they can judge its desirability.

Deze leden wensen een duidelijk beeld van de aanvullende toezichtstaak van de Raad voor de rechtshandhaving te krijgen, ook over de verhouding tot de andere mogelijkheden van controle en aansturing, alvorens zij in staat zijn een oordeel te geven over de wenselijkheid van die toezichtstaak.
Asks who checks the council's powers and whether it investigates individual incidents, and calls for attention to prison oversight.
The SP members note that the Council has powers but may use them only insofar as reasonably necessary. Who reviews this if a dispute arises? Who supervises the Council?

De leden van de SP-fractie constateren dat de Raad bevoegdheden heeft, maar hiervan slechts gebruik mag maken voor zover dat redelijkerwijs nodig is. Wie toetst dit als hierover een geschil bestaat? Wie controleert de Raad?
Seeks clear demarcation between the council and existing inspectorates, a definition of management, and the council's composition and chairmanship.
They also see the risk of excessive inspection burden, overlap with the work of existing inspectorates and associated competence disputes.
Deze leden zien ook het risico van een te grote inspectiedrukte, overlap met werkzaamheden van bestaande inspectiediensten en daarmee samenhangende competentiegeschillen.
Argues police quality should remain with the police itself and questions the council's role, and objects that agencies are notified before reports are issued.
This is inconsistent with the idea of keeping the Council independent of the responsible minister(s).
Dit strookt niet met het idee de Raad onafhankelijk te laten zijn van de verantwoordelijke minister(s).
Asks about legal protection against decisions on publication of reports and departures from the council's advice, and about incompatibility rules for members.

v.summary: The Council of State of the Kingdom advised revising the draft Rijkswet establishing the Raad voor de rechtshandhaving (law enforcement council) for Curaçao, Sint Maarten and the BES islands, on scope of inspection, relation to national inspectorates, inspection of police, prosecution and prisons, drafting of article 1, and hearing duties in complaint advice. The government's reply accepted most points, adding clarifications, a new paragraph on coordination with the Onderzoeksraad, a hearing requirement for the respondent body, and redactional changes, while rejecting the objection to the definition of responsible ministers.
concerns: The scope of inspection in article 3(1)(c) was too open-ended and needed to be limited and clarified in the explanatory memorandum.
The general inspection powers of the Rvdr over the police and prosecution service were doubted as a necessary addition, especially regarding the judicial character of the Openbaar Ministerie.
The relation between the Rvdr and national inspection services in the countries needed clearer explanation in the explanatory memorandum.
The explanatory memorandum should address prison detention conditions and the responsibilities of ministers for meeting international standards.
Article 1 was considered insufficiently clear about the designation of responsible ministers and definitions of custodial terms should be added.
Complaint advice procedure should give the administrative body concerned a hearing in addition to the complainant.
Several redactional comments in the annex were adopted.

32123-XIV.s: This bill fixes the 2010 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, with expenditure and revenue figures by policy article, and the operating budgets of six agencies (AID, DLG, DR, DICT, PD, VWA). The explanatory memorandum describes budget presentation changes, policy priorities, agency financing and performance indicators, with no provision delegating rule-making or shifting powers.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for the year 2010 attached to this law is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV) voor het jaar 2010 wordt vastgesteld.

32123-XVI.s: This bill sets the 2010 budget appropriations for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the baten-lastendiensten (agencies operating on a revenue-expenditure accounting basis). It also introduces a temporary experiment changing how the departmental budget and its explanatory information are presented, deviating from articles 5 and 14 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
32123-XVI.j: The memorandum justifies the departure from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 by the need to run a government-wide experiment improving political accountability, to be evaluated in 2010.
q: The experiment will be evaluated in 2010.
Het experiment zal worden geëvalueerd in 2010.

32186-(R1901).s: This bill amends numerous kingdom acts (rijkswetten) to adapt them to the transformation of the Netherlands Antilles, making Curaçao and Sint Maarten countries within the Kingdom and turning Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba into public bodies of the Netherlands. It mainly replaces references to the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba and reallocates administrative competences among the Netherlands, the new countries, the public bodies and their governors.
32186-(R1901).j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial delegation for amending amounts and references by the complexity of the legislative operation and the tight deadline, and notes the delegation is narrowly bounded.
q: only the amounts currently stated in Netherlands Antillean guilders and the references to national regulations may be adjusted
alleen de bedragen die nu in Nederlands Antilliaanse Guldens staan opgenomen en de verwijzingen naar landsregelgeving kunnen worden aangepast
d: rules on issuing travel documents to persons admitted in Aruba, Curaçao or Sint Maarten
adjusting amounts in Netherlands Antillean guilders and references to national regulations to a possible new currency
rules on coordination between the Safety Board, prosecutors and police in the Caribbean public bodies
p: The Safety Board may conduct investigations in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including unrequested ones, treating these bodies like Dutch municipalities.
Military criminal jurisdiction for the Caribbean is reorganised within the Joint Court of Justice, with the military prosecutor's competences restated.

parties: Asks whether the Paspoortwet change on the right to return to one's own country conflicts with ICCPR article 12(4) and whether a second tranche of amendments is coming.

Besides the consideration that a person must be able to return to their residence, the legislative history shows this provision was primarily inserted in connection with the right of nationals to return to their own country under ICCPR article 12(4).

Naast de overweging dat iemand naar zijn woonplaats moet kunnen terugkeren, volgt uit de wetsgeschiedenis dat deze bepaling primair is ingevoegd in verband met het recht van onderdanen van een bepaalde staat die de nationaliteit van die staat bezitten, om terug te keren naar hun eigen land.
Asks whether the change from 'land' to 'woonplaats' may leave people unable to return to their own country, possibly contrary to the ICCPR, and whether the bill should be amended.
This change may unintentionally mean that a person no longer residing in one of the Kingdom's countries cannot return to their own country, which may conflict with the ICCPR.

Deze wijziging kan als onbedoeld gevolg hebben dat iemand die niet langer woonachtig is in een van de landen van het Koninkrijk niet meer terug kan keren naar zijn eigen land, wat in strijd kan zijn met het IVBPR.

Criticises the delayed tax framework and the removal of corporate profit tax on the BES islands, which it sees as creating a tax haven, and asks for justification and a timetable before the Kingdom tax regulation is approved.
The SP finally finds it incomprehensible that a new tax haven is being created within the Netherlands by scrapping corporate profit tax on the BES islands.
De leden van de SP vinden het ten slotte onbegrijpelijk dat er binnen Nederland een nieuw belastingparadijs wordt gecreëerd door op de BES-eilanden de winstbelasting te schrappen.
Argues the bill is largely technical and that related consensus legislation should be debated in parliament first; also asks about pension amounts and fine levels.

They are however of the view that other bills, such as the consensus Statute Kingdom Act, must first be treated in parliament on the merits before this bill is considered for final debate in the House.

Zij zijn evenwel van mening dat procedureel andere wetsvoorstellen, zoals de consensus rijkswet Statuut, ten principale parlementair behandeld dienen te worden alvorens onderhavig wetsvoorstel voor definitieve bespreking in de Tweede Kamer in aanmerking komt.

Asks the government to await the Bonaire referendum result before proceeding, opposes extending voting rights, and questions limits on the Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid's powers and the immigration regime on the islands.
They ask the government to first await the outcome of the referendum on Bonaire before proceeding with the state reform process.
Zij verzoeken de regering eerst de uitslag van het referendum op Bonaire af te wachten voordat zij verder gaat met de voortgang van het staatkundige hervormingsproces.
Supports the dismantling of the Netherlands Antilles but asks for a simpler procedure for Governors to deploy the armed forces in hurricane disasters on the new countries.
The D66 members ask the government to pay attention to the arrangement and procedure by which the Governors of the new countries can obtain the armed forces to combat natural disasters.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering aandacht te schenken aan de regeling en procedure waarmee de Gouverneurs van de nieuwe landen de krijgsmacht ter beschikking kunnen krijgen ter bestrijding van natuurrampen.
The statutory duty to consult and account to The Hague under article 15 would turn Curaçao into a de facto colony and reduce its policy freedom, and the party questions who pays the governors' costs.
Instead of more policy space or freedom, we as a new autonomous country are legally obliged to consult on a broad range of topics with and, as it were, account to The Hague.

In plaats van meer beleidsruimte cq beleidsvrijheid worden wij als nieuw autonoom land wettelijk verplicht om over een breed scala van onderwerpen overleg te voeren met en als het ware verantwoording af te leggen aan Den Haag.
The party considers the adjustment of the rijkswetten indispensable for the new state structure and asks whether the Raad van Advies suggestions will be taken into account.
The party points out, needlessly perhaps, that the bill adjusting the rijkswetten to the creation of the new countries is indispensable.
De fractie wijst er ten overvloede op dat het voorstel van rijkswet tot aanpassing van de rijkswetten aan de oprichting van de nieuwe landen onontbeerlijk is.

v.summary: The Raad van State van het Koninkrijk supports the bill adapting Kingdom statutes to the new status of Curaçao and Sint Maarten and the Caribbean municipalities, but raises concerns about consultation with the Governors, the Caribbean tax regulation, and missing transitional law. The government's reply accepts most points, adjusts the text and explanatory memorandum, and explains why some remarks were not followed.
concerns: The Governor consultation provision should be reformulated so that it does not suggest a hierarchical relationship; the word 'uitnodigen' is avoided.

Transitional provisions are needed so that years of main residence in the Netherlands Antilles count for Dutch nationality and so that Antillean NV and BV companies are covered by the seat-transfer law.
References to 'deel' and 'delen' of the Kingdom in the seat-transfer law are to be avoided or defined, given the five parts in practice.

The fine increase in the Military Disciplinary Code appeared to be a typographical error and the Raad asked for correction or justification; the government instead used the amounts already set by a recent law.
The Belastingregeling voor het Koninkrijk should explain expected consequences of a future Caribbean tax system and its timetable; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.

The Raad asked that the Belastingregeling distinguish European Netherlands from the Caribbean public bodies in tripartite situations; the government declined for now, citing the limited purpose of the bill.
Numerous redactional remarks in the annex on structure, citation titles, and cross-references were largely taken over.

32222-XIV.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, adjusting expenditure, commitments and receipts across policy and non-policy articles in line with the Autumn Memorandum (Najaarsnota). It sets the amended budget in thousands of euros and specifies its entry into force as 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
32222-XIV.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to specific programmes, such as the Productschap voor de Tuinbouw ruling and Natura 2000 management costs, rather than by any claim to new powers.
q: We Beatrix, by the grace of God, Queen of the Netherlands, Princess of Orange-Nassau, etc. etc. etc. To all who shall see or hear read these presents, greetings!
Wij Beatrix, bij de gratie Gods, Koningin der Nederlanden, Prinses van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz. Allen, die deze zullen zien of horen lezen, saluut!

32222-XVI.s: This is a supplementary budget bill amending the 2009 expenditure and revenue statements of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It contains no new delegations of rule-making power and only a formal provision on the amounts being set in thousands of euros and the entry-into-force date.
q: Is amended as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32415-(R1915).s: The bill sets out the main lines of visa policy for entry into Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten and the Caribbean public bodies, harmonising visa issuance across the Kingdom under a Kingdom law basis. It establishes visa requirements, application and refusal criteria, and attaches the power to set exemptions, conditions and procedures largely to ministerial regulation and country regulation.
32415-(R1915).j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for uniform visa policy across the Kingdom and by the foreign minister's responsibility for foreign affairs, stating that exercise of powers cannot depend on the consent of the countries.
q: However important consultation and cooperation are, the exercise of those powers cannot be made dependent on the consent of the countries.
Hoe belangrijk overleg en samenwerking ook zijn, de uitoefening van die bevoegdheden kan niet afhankelijk worden gesteld van de instemming van de landen.
d: visa exemptions for nationalities and categories
stay duration attached to visa via country regulation
application form and alternative application locations
further rules on public order, security and means of subsistence criteria
rules on proof of purpose and circumstances of stay
p: Authority may grant a visa despite failing entry criteria where a substantial national interest, humanitarian reasons or international relations so require, a broad discretionary exception.
Authority may attach restrictions and conditions to visas and may amend or revoke visas on broadly framed grounds.
Foreign minister's view on foreign-policy interests must be taken into account in visa decisions, a consultation rather than a binding check.
Disputes between the foreign minister and country authorities may be referred to the Council of Ministers of the Kingdom, centralising decision power over country visa matters.

parties: Asks how far the islands can deviate from the Kingdom's visa policy, how inter-territory disagreements are resolved, and what happens if a territory ignores the minister's view, raising concerns about illegal immigration spillover.

What if it turns out that the countries are too lenient in granting visas to foreigners, in relation to the emergence of a new illegal population on the islands and the possible consequences for arrivals in the European part of the Kingdom?

Wat als blijkt dat de landen te soepel omgaan met het verlenen van visa aan vreemdelingen, een en ander in relatie tot het ontstaan van een nieuwe illegalenpopulatie op de eilanden en de eventuele gevolgen daarvan voor de komst naar het Europese deel van het Koninkrijk?
Asks whether the territories accept that visa policy is a Kingdom rather than a national matter, and what kinds of provisions may be elaborated in territorial regulations.
For example, does the government of the Netherlands Antilles share this view?
Deelt bijvoorbeeld de regering van de Nederlandse Antillen deze mening ook?

Supports harmonisation but asks the government to address the Council of State's advice, to secure uniform enforcement against visa fraud, and to clarify whether individual exemptions could become categorical ones and how the rights of appeal work.
They ask whether the authorities on the islands are sufficiently equipped to detect and counter such fraud and abuse.
Zij vragen of de instanties op de eilanden voldoende zijn ingesteld op het ontdekken en tegengaan van zulke fraude en misbruik.

Questions why the Dutch Foreign Minister holds broad visa powers for the countries while the bill omits to make him the competent authority there, and asks whether the Statute permits this and how disputes would be settled by an independent body.
Can the government explain why this construction was chosen in the bill, given that the draft concerns provisions on granting visas for entry into the countries of the Kingdom?

Kan de regering aangeven waarom is gekozen voor zo een constructie in het wetsvoorstel, terwijl het onderhavig ontwerp betreft «Bepalingen omtrent de verlening van visa voor de toegang tot de landen van het Koninkrijk»?

Argues the bill rests on an inadequate statutory basis under the Statute, that the advisory councils' objections were ignored, and that Aruba can only consent if the law is based on consensus under Article 38.
A national visa act whose statutory basis lies solely in Article 3, subsection g, would be in conflict with the Statute.
Een Rijksvisumwet waarvan de statutaire grondslag is gelegen in uitsluitend artikel 3, onderdeel g, zou in strijd zijn met het Statuut.

Contends the bill lacks an adequate legal basis and in effect amends the Statute, asks why the other Kingdom partners should accept it, and proposes an amendment requiring acceptance by the Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten parliaments.
It is inadmissible and highly undemocratic that the Statute could be amended indirectly without following the aggravated procedure prescribed in Article 55 of the Statute.

Immers, het is ontoelaatbaar en uiterst ondemocratisch dat het Statuut op indirecte wijze zou kunnen worden gewijzigd, zonder dat de verzwaarde procedure als voorgeschreven in artikel 55 van het Statuut wordt gevolgd.

Argues the statutory basis is wrong (visa policy is mainly a country matter) and that Article 4 wrongly lets the Kingdom minister give instructions during implementation; proposes regulation by consensus arrangement instead.
According to the PAR faction, Article 4 should only regulate the actual mandating of handling visa applications on behalf of the authorities.
Volgens de PAR-fractie moet artikel 4 alleen de feitelijke mandatering van het behandelen van visumaanvragen, namens de autoriteiten, te regelen.
Opposes elevating a country matter to a Kingdom matter, arguing it erodes Curaçao's autonomy and sits outside democratic control of the country's elected bodies.
Country matters belong in local country ordinances, and where cooperation is evident or desired, the Statute already offers arrangements under Article 38(1) that leave autonomous competences intact.

Landszaken horen thuis in lokale landsverordeningen en daar waar samenwerking evident en/of gewenst is, biedt het Statuut reeds mogelijkheden daartoe in de vorm van onderlinge regelingen op grond van artikel 38 lid 1.

Questions procedural correctness, requests Rijksministerraad documents and instructions to the Gevolmachtigde Minister, and points to a democratic deficit preventing adequate control of the Kingdom government.
Can the Government be asked to send all documents on the decision-making in the Council of Ministers of the Kingdom on this draft to the Staten?
Kan aan de Regering gevraagd worden om alle stukken betreffende de besluitvorming in de Rijksministerraad over dit ontwerp aan de Staten te zenden?
Says the country has no input into Kingdom statutes and that the minister of Foreign Affairs alone effectively fills them in; views the bill as colonial and calls for independence.
This also indicates that the actual implementation of the Rijkswet is done solely by the Minister of Foreign Affairs.
Dit geeft tevens aan dat het uiteindelijk invulling van de rijkswet, enkel en alleen door de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken geschiedt.
Wants the bill arranged so it does not hinder free movement and trade in the region, with exemptions for economically and tourism-important countries, and hopes the democratic deficit is removed.
Countries that are both economically important and important for tourism should be exempted from any form of visa requirement.
Landen die zowel van economisch belang zijn als voor toerisme moeten uitgezonderd worden van elke vorm van visumplicht.

The bill would give the Dutch Foreign Minister sole responsibility over visa policy without requiring consent of the other Kingdom countries, and the proposal was never formally submitted through Statuut procedures.
This view does not correspond to the fact that admission and expulsion at the national level are a competence of the countries.
Deze opvatting correspondeert niet met het feit dat toelating en uitzetting op nationaal niveau een bevoegdheid van de landen is.

v.summary: The Council of State of the Kingdom advised on the draft Rijksvisumwet, endorsing its aim but raising points on the statutory basis, the level of implementing rules, mutual validity of visas, transparency of policy, Papiamentu applications, and passport law parallels. The government's nader rapport accepted some redactional remarks but rejected most substantive recommendations, justifying this by flexibility needs and the fluid nature of foreign policy.
concerns: The Council asked that the advisory opinions of the Caribbean Advisory Councils, proposing article 38 of the Statute as an additional basis, be addressed; the government saw no reason to change the statutory basis but added a passage on it.
The Council advised that the main elements of implementing rules for the public bodies be set by general administrative order rather than ministerial regulation, which the government did not adopt.

The Council was concerned that visas could be used for shopping for the least strict means-of-subsistence requirement and asked for explanation of mutual validity; the government added a passage on harmonisation via consultation.
The Council was not convinced that the foreign policy basis is sufficiently knowable and advised laying it down in a circular; the government refused as foreign policy is too fluid for a circular.
The Council asked whether Papiamentu may be used for visa applications; the government declined, citing the location and staffing of Kingdom representations.
The Council noted the parallel with the Paspoortwet on refusing documents where a person may evade prosecution and advised addressing it; the government found the laws not symmetrical.
The Council's redactional remarks were largely adopted, except for those on articles 8, 9, 11 and 14, where terminology was kept in line with existing laws.

32609-XV.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, shifting appropriations across policy articles as an incidental supplementary budget linked to a departmental reorganisation. It also exempts the Spaarfonds AOW budget for 2011 from the Comptabiliteitswet requirement to prepare an annual report and closing balance sheet.
32609-XV.j: The memorandum justifies the exemption by stating that no financial annual statements of the Spaarfonds AOW will be produced for 2011, so the Comptabiliteitswet requirements are set aside for that year.
q: For the year 2011, no accountability therefore takes place on the basis of financial annual statements of the Spaarfonds AOW.
Over het jaar 2011 vindt er dus geen verantwoording plaats aan de hand van financiële jaarstukken van het Spaarfonds AOW.
p: The Minister is exempted from preparing an annual report and closing balance sheet for the Spaarfonds AOW budget for 2011, reducing accountability information available to parliament for that year.

32780-XV.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget statutes of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, adjusting departmental appropriations and operating-cost (baten-lastendiensten) statements in thousands of euros, mainly through the spring memorandum (Voorjaarsnota). It takes effect on 1 June 2011 and applies retroactively if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2011 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33605-VIII.s: This slotwet (final budget adjustment act) for 2012 amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget of the DUO and National Archives service agencies, recording realised spending and receipts against the original and supplementary budgets. It also creates a multi-year budget reserve as a fiscal provision for state guarantees on residual debts of education institutions that default on loans.
q: There is an overrun of € 3.1 million on the budget for learner-linked funding (LGF).
Er is een overschrijding van € 3,1 miljoen op het budget voor leerlinggebonden financiering (LGF).

34085-XV.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statements of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and its agency, changing appropriations by article in thousands of euros, with effect from 1 December 2014. It adjusts spending and revenue lines through the Najaarsnota supplementary budget, with no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

34350-XIII.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2015 budget statements for the Ministry of Economic Affairs, its agencies, and the animal health fund, adjusting spending, commitments and revenue across energy, agriculture, education and innovation items. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2015 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34485-XII.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment and the budget for its agencies, adjusting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. It takes effect on 1 June 2016 or the day after publication of the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 June if published later.

34550-VIII.s: This bill fixes the 2017 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget statement for its agencies, in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum excerpt describes spending priorities, performance indicators, and budget execution across education, culture and research, with no new delegations of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2017 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34620-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2016 budget statements of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the agencies under it, and the Animal Health Fund through a second supplementary budget. It changes appropriations and revenue lines and sets the budget amounts in thousands of euros, effective from 1 December 2016.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for the year 2016 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34730-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2017 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget statement of the agency DUO, raising spending and receipts to reflect higher student numbers, a higher dollar cost for Caribbean Netherlands, and other reallocations. The explanatory memorandum explains the budgetary effects per policy article and provides no delegation of rule-making or decision power.
q: The 2017 reference projection shows that the expected number of pupils and students is higher than the numbers processed in the OCW budget 2017.
Uit de referentieraming 2017 blijkt dat het aantal verwachte leerlingen en studenten hoger uitvalt dan de in de OCW-begroting 2017 verwerkte aantallen.

34733-(R2090).s: The bill implements EU Directive 2015/637 by giving non-represented EU citizens in third countries the right to Dutch consular protection on the same footing as Dutch nationals, when their own member state is not represented or cannot provide adequate help. It also sets identification rules, allows the minister to recover costs from the citizen's home state, and provides for the citizen to repay costs under a signed debt declaration.
34733-(R2090).j: The memorandum justifies the bill as necessary to implement Directive 2015/637 and does not give a separate justification for the delegation of the model debt declaration.
d: model debt declaration for repayment of consular costs

parties: Asks whether consultation before assistance is mandatory and who determines extremely urgent cases, since the bill itself does not make this clear.
Therefore the VVD members wonder to what extent there is an obligation to consult, since this is insufficiently clear from the bill itself.
Derhalve vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie zich af in hoeverre hier sprake is van een verplichting tot consultatie, aangezien dit onvoldoende uit het voorstel van rijkswet zelf blijkt.
Questions the absence of a legally enforceable right to consular protection and of minimum standards, raising risk of arbitrariness, and asks about cost recovery limits.
The D66 members note that Dutch legislation does not anchor a legally enforceable right to consular protection.
De leden van de D66-fractie constateren dat in Nederlandse wetgeving geen juridisch afdwingbaar recht op consulaire bescherming is verankerd.
Supports implementation and asks about practical consequences and how implementation proceeds in other member states.
The GroenLinks members welcome the implementation of this directive and therefore support the bill.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks verwelkomen de implementatie van deze richtlijn en steunen derhalve het wetsvoorstel.

34775-VII.s: This bill fixes the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations and the budget statement of the agency Rijksdienst voor Identiteitsgegevens, in thousands of euros. It sets the entry into force on 1 January of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2018 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

34845-XII.s: This bill amends the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (XII) and the related budget statements for its executive agencies (Rijkswaterstaat, ILT, KNMI, Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit) in a second supplementary budget. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force as 1 December 2017 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (XII)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu (XII)

35210-XIV.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2019 budget statements of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the NVWA agency, and the Animal Health Fund. The explanatory memorandum attributes the adjustments to higher-than-expected spending on agricultural policy, a court ruling on NVWA fees, and a reallocation from the Regio envelope.
35210-XIV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by citing a College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven ruling on NVWA retributions, extra RVO workload from phosphate rights procedures, and CAP implementation costs.
q: The Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal ruled, in a case on fees the NVWA charges slaughterhouses for meat inspection, that internal initial training costs for veterinarians or assistants may not form part of the fee tariff.

Het College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven (CBb) heeft, in een zaak over retributies die de NVWA slachterijen in rekening brengen voor het keuren van vlees, geoordeeld dat de interne initiële opleidingskosten tot dierenarts of assistent geen onderdeel mogen uitmaken van het retributietarief.

35210-XVI.s: The bill amends the 2019 departmental budget (first supplementary budget) of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, changing appropriations for care, youth, sport and agency budgets in thousands of euros. It sets entry into force from 1 June 2019 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: We ... have approved and resolved ... The departmental budget statement for 2019 is amended
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd

35300-XIV.s: This bill is the 2020 budget law for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the NVWA agency and the Animal Health Fund, fixing expenditure and revenue ceilings in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum covers policy priorities such as NVWA supervision, nature and agricultural programmes, and does not itself delegate rule-making or shift powers.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2020 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorend de departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises that it has no substantive remarks on the 2020 budget bills for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) and the Animal Health Fund (F), recommending submission to parliament with only one drafting correction in article 3. The Minister of Finance, on behalf of the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, submits a nader rapport stating that changes to several budgets are necessary and referring to attached annexes.
concerns: The Afdeling proposes a redactional change in article 3 replacing 'het begrotingsfonds' with a reference to the Diergezondheidsfonds under article 95a of the Gezondheids- en welzijnswet voor dieren.

35300-XVI.s: This bill, the 2020 budget act for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, fixes the departmental expenditure and receipts statement and the agency budget statements for 2020 in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum sets out policy priorities and budget tables for the ministry's articles and agencies, without delegating rule-making power to the executive.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement for the year 2020 attached to this act is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued blanket advice (no remarks) on the 2020 budget bills for all ministries, including the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, and recommended submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's reply states that some budgets need amendments, which are set out in annexes to the nader rapport.

35450-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (OCW) and the budget statement for the agency DUO, shifting several billion euros of appropriations and adjusting revenue and expenditure lines. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides that the act takes effect on 1 May 2020, with retroactive effect if published later.
35450-VIII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to shortfalls in primary education, newcomer funding and student finance, offset by an end-of-year budget surplus, without any new delegation of powers.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have approved and resolved ... The departmental budget statement for the year 2020 is amended.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd.

35570-XV.s: This is the 2021 budget bill (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, setting authorised expenditure and receipts of about 52.4 billion euros across labour market, benefits, childcare, disability and pension policy articles. The accompanying memorandum describes budgetary developments, COVID-19 emergency measures, and implementation by UWV, SVB and municipalities without introducing new delegated rule-making powers.
35570-XV.j: The memorandum justifies the emergency COVID-19 measures as necessary to keep the virus under control and to preserve jobs, but it does not justify any new delegation.
q: The cabinet was forced to take measures to bring the virus under control.
Het kabinet was genoodzaakt maatregelen te nemen om het virus onder controle te krijgen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2021 budget bill for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV), raising no remarks and recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport, submitted by the Minister of Finance on behalf of the Minister of Social Affairs, notes that the Afdeling had no objections to the XV budget and sets out proposed technical amendments to several budgets.

35925-XII.s: This bill fixes the 2022 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (HXII) and the agency budget statements, including Rijkswaterstaat and the KNMI, in thousands of euros. The memorandum extract covers policy articles on water, roads, public transport, aviation, shipping, environment, meteorology and inspection (ILT), but contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2022 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that it has no remarks on the draft 2022 budget act for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat (XII) and recommends submitting it to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport states that, since a change to some budgets has become necessary, amendments are set out in annexes to the reply.

36200-XIV.s: The bill sets the 2023 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (LNV), the operating budgets of the agencies (including the NVWA), and the Diergezondheidsfonds budget. The explanatory memorandum concerns budget allocations, NVWA retribution and supervision, and parliamentary motions on food and animal supervision.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2023 belonging to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued a blanket opinion on the 2023 budget bills (begrotingsstaten), raising no objections to the proposal. The Minister of Finance, on behalf of the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, replied in a nader rapport that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes.

36200-XVI.s: This bill fixes the 2023 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the budget statements for its agencies, in thousands of euros, with effect from 1 January 2023. The attached explanatory memorandum sets out spending priorities and existing guarantee and oversight arrangements, without creating new executive delegations of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2023 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2023 budget bill for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) and raised no remarks, recommending that the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport states that changes to several budgets have become necessary and refers to attachments with these amendments.

36350-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget statement for the agency DUO, adjusting expenditure, commitments and revenue by article, with effect from the day after publication and retroactive to 21 April 2023. The explanatory memorandum describes the budget mutations, price adjustments and student-number projections, and does not involve delegation of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement annexed to this act.

Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36470-XV.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, with a net decrease of about 214 million euros in commitments and expenditure, mainly on disability benefits (WAO, IVA, WGA). It also adjusts smaller items such as the sick-leave and occupational-disease schemes and the asbestos victims compensation, and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2023.
q: The total of the changes in the second supplementary budget amounts to minus 214.1 million euros in commitments and expenditure.
Het totaal van de mutaties 2e suppletoire begroting bedraagt ‒ € 214,1 miljoen bij de verplichtingen en uitgaven.

36560-XV.s: This Slotwet (final budget act) amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for 2023, adjusting appropriations and expenditure per budget article to match realised figures. It also sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the act effective retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36600-XIII.s: This bill formally establishes the 2025 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII), setting expenditure, obligations and receipts by policy article in thousands of euros. It also fixes the 2025 budget statements for the agencies (baten-lastenagentschappen: Dienst ICT Uitvoering, RVO, RDI), with entry into force on 1 January of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2025 belonging to this law is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

36740-XV.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (Slotwet), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts per policy article. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2024 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.
